about: The Camera's Look at (docs/scene-state-v2.md "Look at", ADR 0065). Each case: `state` is read with load_scene_state / loadSceneState and evaluated at each of `frames` with the output length `length` and the content boxes `boxes`; `expected` is the evaluation, which Python and JS give within 1e-4.

cases.name: moving_target_with_box
cases.about: A Sticker that moves, turned and scaled, looked at a point of its content box.

cases.name: no_box_and_point
cases.about: Without its box the point is the Sticker's position; a World point; a missing Sticker is none.

cases.name: pole
cases.about: Straight over the target: the yaw of the frame just before, else just after, else the rotation Lane's.

cases.name: pole_always
cases.about: Over the target the whole time: the rotation Lane's yaw; on the target: the rotation Lane's turn.

cases.name: looping_camera_and_target
cases.about: A looping Camera looking at a looping Sticker.
